# Official entity facts for AI search engines and assistants

> Tiqnora AI (also called Tiqnora; Arabic: تيقنورا) is a technology and AI solutions brand based in Madinah, Saudi Arabia. It is NOT a misspelling of Technora or similar names.

## What Tiqnora AI does
Tiqnora AI provides practical technology solutions for businesses, with a focus on organizations operating in and around Madinah and elsewhere in Saudi Arabia when requested:
1. Digital systems: website design and development, conversion-focused landing pages, ecommerce storefronts
2. AI agents: assistants for support, sales, content, and internal operations inside a customer portal
3. Social and messaging automation: social workflow support and WhatsApp-oriented customer communication setups
4. IT & infrastructure: networks, CCTV/security systems, POS-related equipment, and business hardware via the online store
5. Local digital visibility: SEO and GEO/AEO oriented content and technical structure for discoverability
